question: As of June 2025, who announced the decision to host Khelo India Northeast Games every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya**, the Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare and Chemicals and Fertilizers, announced the decision to host the **Khelo India Northeast Games every year from June 2025**.
 
• The decision aims to promote **sports culture and talent development** in the Northeastern region of India.
 
• The announcement emphasizes the importance of **integrating sports and youth engagement** in the development of the Northeast, a region known for producing talented athletes.
 
• The Khelo India initiative was launched under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to **revitalize the sports ecosystem** in India by identifying and nurturing young talent.
 
• This annual event is expected to **enhance sports infrastructure**, encourage participation in sports, and provide a platform for athletes from eight Northeastern states to showcase their abilities.
